title: Correct time value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct numerical value for the time of flight, t = √3 s or approximately 1.732 s.

title: Correct height value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct numerical value for the height AB, h = 25 m.

title: Perpendicular impact condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the condition that the ball's velocity is perpendicular to the slope upon impact, relating the velocity components using the incline angle.

title: Vertical motion analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply kinematic equations for vertical motion under constant gravity to find the vertical velocity and displacement.

title: Geometric height calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly combine the vertical drop and the horizontal displacement (using the slope angle) to find the total height AB.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student's final answers should include correct SI units (s and m) or demonstrate consistent unit analysis throughout.

title: Sign error in velocity relation
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly relates the horizontal and vertical velocity components for the perpendicular impact condition (e.g., using the wrong trigonometric function or sign).

title: Confusing height components
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student confuses the vertical drop from A with the total height AB, or incorrectly calculates the vertical contribution from the horizontal displacement.
